notes: The scheduler's list, present but switched off. Run the commands by hand first - a scheduler that starts a command you have never seen succeed only makes the failure harder to find.
Set 'active': true on both entries and start the daemon (step 6 of the README) once the manual runs are clean.

'working_dir' is the literal string 'tools/db_ops' and is not a folder on your disk. It is a logical alias for the tool root, resolved at run time to wherever the project actually lives, so the same file works in a checkout and in the container.

Metrics repeats every 5 minutes and is allowed 20; reports repeat every 5 minutes and are allowed 10. The timeout is always the budget for the WHOLE pass, so it stays above the slowest single thing in it - a pass killed at its timeout loses every metric in it, not just the slow one.
